parts.name: enclosure-back-top
parts.model_overhangs_review: 15 measured support bodies (6 bed-rooted, 9 model-rooted), 44 labelled interface islands and one unlabelled exterior ribbon, against the 09-21 v2 slice's 11 bodies and 38 islands. 37 contacts are v2's, carried by position with their lanes; new are the ASSE lane floor (the audit's shared pocket and tie roof), the co2-2 anchor crown moved with the PI450822S chain, and five thin contact lines on the PRV chase's 45° face. v2's single exterior bed tree with 29 contacts is split here into five bed trees, which is most of the body count's rise. The 0 to 2.6 mm band prints the R6 roof side edges on 0.08 mm layers where they rise off the bed; the unlabelled ribbon along the east roof edge is v2's. The part sits 8 mm back from centre so the rear-face tree keeps 4.3 mm of bed. The C14 seating floor, pan bearing floor, round seats, tie channels, snap shoulders and broad seam-foot faces remain intact. Supports are detached in branches while the quadrant is empty; physical effort is unmeasured.
